content:
re : I also need to be able to stop it putting things in 'Sent'.

If you use IMAP then some servers will auto save anything you send in the server 'Sent' folder. For example, gmail will always put anything you send via gmail into the server default 'Sent' folder. So, you will always see the email gmail put in 'Sent' when using IMAP. Nothing you can do about what the server does automatically.

In Thunderbird - You determine where to put 'Sent' emails in this location

  • 'Account Settings' > 'Copies & Folders' for the mail account

IF using a 'Sent' folder in same account then: Select: 'Place a copy in' Select: 'Sent folder on' and choose the mail account name

IF you want to save all sent mail in another account such as the 'Local Folders' select 'Other' and choose 'Sent on Local Folders' OR if a non default location - a folder you created eg: 'Sent 2026' Select 'Other' and choose eg: 'Sent 2026 on mail account name'

If in TB you have successfully created a CalDav calendar for your iPhone calendar it should automatically (or manually) sync with your iPhone!! If in the future you will use only the CalDav calendar and disable the Home calendar, you can merge them as follows: R-click on Home calendar > Export Calendar...., choose *.ics as format and save as "Home.ics" file; in the TB menu go to Tools > Import... > Import from a file > Import Calendars, navigate to and select the "Home.ics" file and click "Open", then "Continue" and select your CalDav calendar to import the chosen items (second image)
